cases.sentence: Он позвал ___, своего старшего сына, и сказал ему.
cases.translation: He called Esau, his elder son, and said to him.
cases.explain: Исав is the direct object of позвал (called); for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive → Исава.

cases.translation: Rebekah said to her son Jacob.
cases.explain: Сын is the addressee of сказала (said to) — the indirect object → dative.

cases.sentence: Ревекка взяла лучшую одежду Исава, какая была у неё в ___.
cases.translation: Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau that were with her in the house.
cases.explain: В marking a static location (in the house) takes the prepositional → доме.

cases.sentence: Ах, запах моего сына, как запах ___, которое благословил Господь!
cases.translation: Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed!
cases.explain: Запах поля ('smell of a field') expresses possession → genitive → поля.

cases.sentence: Ты будешь жить ___ и будешь служить своему брату.
cases.translation: You will live by the sword and will serve your brother.
cases.explain: The means by which he will live ('by the sword') is expressed by the instrumental → мечом.

cases.sentence: Как пришёл с охоты его ___ Исав.
cases.translation: …when his brother Esau came in from the hunt.
cases.explain: Брат is the subject who performs пришёл (came in) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Исав затаил злобу на Иакова из-за ___, которое дал ему отец.
cases.translation: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father gave him.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (because of) governs the genitive → благословения.

cases.sentence: Пойди к ___ и принеси мне двух лучших козлят.
cases.translation: Go to the flock and bring me two of the best young goats.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative → стаду.

reading.ru: Возьми же свое оружие, колчан и лук, и выйди в поле добыть мне дичи.
reading.question: What did Isaac tell Esau to go out and get for him?
reading.explain: Isaac told Esau to take his weapons and go to the field to get him game.

reading.ru: Мать сказала ему, «Проклятие пусть будет на мне, сын мой, а ты делай, как я говорю, пойди и принеси козлят».
reading.question: What did Rebekah say she would take upon herself?
reading.explain: Rebekah told Jacob to obey her and let any curse fall on her.

reading.ru: Иаков подошел ближе к своему отцу Исааку, который ощупал его и сказал, «Голос, как голос Иакова, но руки, как руки Исаава».
reading.question: What contradiction did Isaac notice when he felt his son?
options: The voice was Jacob's but the hands were Esau's
reading.correct: The voice was Jacob's but the hands were Esau's
reading.explain: Isaac said the voice was Jacob's voice but the hands were the hands of Esau.

reading.ru: Он не узнал его, потому что руки у него были волосатые, как у Исаава, и он благословил его.
reading.question: Why did Isaac fail to recognize Jacob?
options: His hands were hairy like Esau's
reading.correct: His hands were hairy like Esau's
reading.explain: Isaac did not recognize him because his hands were hairy like Esau's.

reading.ru: Услышав слова отца, Исав громко и горько закричал и сказал отцу, «Благослови меня, и меня тоже, отец!»
reading.question: How did Esau react when he learned the blessing was gone?
options: He cried out loudly and bitterly
reading.correct: He cried out loudly and bitterly
reading.explain: Esau cried out with a loud and bitter cry, begging his father to bless him too.

reading.ru: Исав затаил злобу на Иакова из-за благословения, которое дал ему отец, и сказал себе, «Не плачи по отцу близки, тогда я убью моего брата Иакова».
reading.question: Why did Esau hold a grudge against Jacob?
options: Because of the blessing Jacob had taken
reading.correct: Because of the blessing Jacob had taken
reading.explain: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing his father had given Jacob.
